svg.title: A proper seven-coloring of the plane by hexagons
svg.desc: Regular hexagons of circumradius 2/5 tile the plane. Centres a + b omega of the triangular lattice get colour (a + 2b) mod 7, the seven cosets of the index-seven sublattice generated by 2 - omega. Each hexagon has diameter 0.8, and hexagons of the same colour are more than 1 apart.
svg.text: Each hexagon is 0.8 across, so no two of its points are 1 apart.
The thick outline shows 7 hexagons using each color once; the pattern repeats.
Same-colored hexagons (dashed: centers √21·r ≈ 1.83 apart) are more than 1 apart.
